name: VPN
author: VanillaGreen
description: Connect your saved VPN and WireGuard profiles.

autoConnect.label: Profile
autoConnect.description: Connects on a network not on your trusted list
autoConnect.info: When this computer joins a network that is not on your trusted list, or VGS starts on one, VGS connects this profile by itself. A wired network is trusted by its router and its address range. With the kill switch on, the block is in place before it connects. If you turn the VPN off, it stays off until this computer changes networks.

trustedNetworks.label: Trusted networks
trustedNetworks.description: On these networks the VPN does not connect by itself
trustedNetworks.info: Trusting a saved Wi-Fi network trusts every network with the same name and password, or the same name when it has no password. Trusting the wired network this computer is on saves its router and address range: a cable to another router is not trusted, but a network that copies both is. If VGS cannot read the router, the wired network is not trusted. A Bluetooth or mobile network is never trusted.

pollSeconds.label: Check every
pollSeconds.description: How often VGS reads your VPN profiles while its flyout and System Settings section are closed

requirements.purpose: Connects OpenVPN profiles and imports OpenVPN files
Adds and changes VPN profiles in NetworkManager's own editor
Reads, connects, imports and removes your VPN profiles
Chooses a VPN file to import
Finds the network your traffic uses, for the leak check, and the router of a wired network, to trust it
Finds the network your DNS lookups use, for the leak check
Asks api.nordvpn.com, through the VPN, for the public address it sees

killSwitch.label: Kill switch
killSwitch.hint: Block traffic outside the VPN when the VPN drops
killSwitch.info: When a VPN you turned on in VGS drops, the kill switch blocks traffic outside it until it connects again or you turn it off in VGS. It works while VGS is not running and after a restart.
